React · Data fetching & APIs

How do you make an API call in React?

Answer

Usually inside useEffect (for data on load) or an event handler (for user actions), with fetch or axios. Track loading/error, and cancel on unmount.

useEffect(() => {
  const controller = new AbortController();
  (async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const { data } = await axios.get(`/api/users/${id}`, { signal: controller.signal });
      setUser(data);
    } catch (e) {
      if (!axios.isCancel(e)) setError(e);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  })();
  return () => controller.abort();
}, [id]);

In real projects: a central API service (axios instance with base URL and interceptors) plus RTK Query / React Query for caching. (The effect callback itself can't be async, so define an async function inside.)
